title: Tejas Nishad — About page liquid-chrome wordmark
note: Borderline: she asked how he did it, not to save it — filed here as the technique breakdown she requested. A stark white About page: a dotted wavy curve draws itself, then becomes his name in Devanagari as thick liquid-chrome 3D lettering overlaid with blue Bezier outlines; the wordmark then warps, stretches and tangles into a dense knot. He cut load time from ~100ms to ~25ms by dropping OGL. What could NOT be verified: the new site is not live at any URL found, and he never says what replaced OGL, so whether the chrome is raw WebGL, pre-rendered or SVG/CSS is unverified. Offered to file as a portfolio find; unanswered.
